raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Mandalay < Sanskrit mandala (circle, sacred enclosure) + -ay (locative suffix in Pali/Burmese); mandala = cosmic diagram",
    "reading": "A sacred circle or bounded cosmic space, a place of ritual enclosure.",
    "languages": ["sa", "pi", "my"],
    "source": "Monier-Williams Sanskrit-English Dictionary, s.v. mandala",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "man + da + lay; man (OE) = human; da (It) = gives; lay (Fr) = the la sound, or Eng. lay = to place",
    "reading": "The human gives a layer — a being who places a foundation upon the earth.",
    "languages": ["en", "it", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Mandalay ~ mandala (Skt) + lai (Fr) = the law; or mande (Fr) = commanded + lait (Fr) = milk",
    "reading": "A commanded milk of the circle — a nourishing decree within a sacred ring.",
    "languages": ["fr", "sa"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Mandalay → 'day + man + al' ; al (Ar) = the; day = light; man = human",
    "reading": "The human of the day, the one who walks in the light of the definite article.",
    "languages": ["en", "ar"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "M-A-N-D-A-L-A-Y → Mem, Aleph, Nun, Dalet, Aleph, Lamed, Aleph, Yod (Hebrew initials)",
    "reading": "Water, ox, fish, door, ox, goad, ox, hand — a primal alphabet of creation.",
    "languages": ["he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "M (13) + A (1) + N (14) + D (4) + A (1) + L (12) + A (1) + Y (25) = 71; 7+1=8; 8 = infinity, regeneration",
    "reading": "The sum reduces to eight — the ouroboros, endless cycle, the eternal return of the circle.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Mandalay in Greek isophony: Μανδαλάι → Μ(40)+Α(1)+Ν(50)+Δ(4)+Α(1)+Λ(30)+Α(1)+Ι(10) = 137; 137 = fine-structure constant, cosmic number",
    "reading": "A hidden cosmic constant — the number of electromagnetic coupling, a world built on precise ratios.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "man + da + lay; da (Skt) = giving; lay (OE) = law; thus 'law-giving man'",
    "reading": "The lawgiver who gives order to the circle — a legislator of sacred space.",
    "languages": ["en", "sa", "oe"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
